name: rust-ext-review-toolkit
description: CPython Rust extension analysis agents: refcount auditing (with borrowed-ref-across-callback detection), error path analysis, NULL safety scanning, GIL discipline checking, module state validation, type slot correctness, stable ABI compliance, version compatibility scanning, PyErr_Clear auditing, resource lifecycle tracking, Python parity checking, complexity measurement, and git history analysis. Tree-sitter-powered Rust parsing with optional rust-analyzer/cargo clippy integration.
